title: World Preview Prime
description: A continuation of the World Preview mod, letting you preview / review a map of a world seed.
body:
# World Preview Prime

**World Preview Prime** is a continuation of the **World Preview** mod that adds a seed viewing map directly into the game. Preview and find a seed before you create a world, or review a seed after you've already created a world with it!

World Preview Prime was forked from the original mod due to inactivity from the original developer. This fork will both continue updating to newer versions and improve on datapack/config configuration.

## Credits

- Thank you to [caeruleusDraconis](https://modrinth.com/user/caeruleusDraconis) for making the original mod. I will always question how you made this mod and remained sane, the code is terrifying.
- Thank you to [ChocoBoy](https://modrinth.com/user/ChocoBoy) for the initial port to 26.1 and adding full Lithostitched compatibility. I would have gone insane if I tried it myself.

## Usage (Preview)

If you wish to **preview** a world seed, go to the Create New World screen and click on the `Preview` tab.

![A map of the world seed with a list of biomes and some buttons on the left](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98120e02e131ef6de6dce11fdb697df1ba26b51a.png)

The most notable change from the original mod so far is the colors: World Preview Prime uses the same biome colors that you would see on Chunkbase or Cubiomes. On top of that, the structure icons now use blocks and items rather than custom textures. They're larger and easier to see, too.

![The same map, but with various items representing structures present](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ff4e2453ff97e9ee808bf94c81fd626134f487d.png)

## Usage (Review)

If you wish to **review** a world seed, press the `World Preview` button in the Pause Menu.

![The pause menu with the new World Preview button highlighted](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85be3f369d2b6216bbef2a4f3fa4815e22317564_0.webp)
